general.intro: Configure application startup, background operation and automatic updates.

openAtStartup.label: Open at startup
openAtStartup.hint: Automatically start Uncached when you log in to your computer.

keepRunning.label: Keep running in the background
keepRunning.hint: Closing the window hides Uncached in the menu bar instead of quitting it. Scheduled maintenance runs from there; Quit ends it until you open the app again.

rememberWorkspace.label: Remember last workspace
rememberWorkspace.hint: Restore your previously open folders and analysis automatically on launch.

checkUpdates.label: Check for updates
checkUpdates.hint: Periodically check for new releases and security improvements.

language.label: Language
language.hint: The interface, the menu bar and notifications.

permanentConfirm.title: Enable permanent deletion?
permanentConfirm.body: Targets are deleted directly from disk instead of moved to the Trash. Not recoverable. Each cleanup will require typing {{word}} to confirm.

opening.intro: Choose which installed application opens when launching a project or terminal.

editor.label: Editor
editor.hint: Left automatic, the editor built for the project's language leads, then any general-purpose one.
editor.empty: No editor was found in your Applications folder.

terminal.label: Terminal
terminal.hint: No platform exposes a default terminal an app opening a directory could read, so automatic is whichever was found first.

opening.detecting: Reading what this machine has installed...
opening.uninstalled: The one you chose is no longer installed, so opening falls back to detection.

scanning.intro: Build artifacts inside your folders are always detected. These are the caches that live elsewhere, written by tools rather than by a project.

packageManagers.label: Package manager caches
packageManagers.hint: Include npm, pnpm, yarn, cargo, pip, and uv global package caches.

aiTools.label: AI tool caches
aiTools.hint: Include Claude Code, the Claude app, Codex, and opencode caches.

editors.label: Editor caches
editors.hint: Include VS Code and JetBrains workspace metadata caches.

gameEngines.label: Game engine caches
gameEngines.hint: Include Unity's package and Asset Store downloads, and Godot's editor cache and export templates.

androidSdk.label: Android SDK
androidSdk.hint: Include downloaded system images and the emulators built from them.

containerStorage.label: Container storage
containerStorage.hint: Report the size of Docker Desktop's disk image. Uncached never removes it.

xcode.label: Xcode developer data
xcode.hint: Include DerivedData, device support, simulators, and simulator runtimes.

scanning.footer: To leave something inside a workspace alone, add it under Ignore rules — a rule there covers every kind of artifact and applies to scheduled runs too.

ignoreRules.intro: Paths listed here are never scanned and never deleted, whatever the app finds there. One rule per line, in <mono>{{syntax}}</mono> syntax — a bare name matches anywhere, a full path matches that path and everything under it, and <mono>{{negation}}</mono> makes an exception.
ignoreRules.problem: <bold>Line {{line}}</bold> could not be read, so it protects nothing: <rule/> — <reason/>
ignoreRules.empty: No rules yet. Everything the scan finds is offered.

deletion.intro: Choose how build artifacts and caches are removed from your disk during cleanup.

trash.label: Move to Trash
trash.hint: Reclaimable artifacts are moved to the system Trash, so cleanups can be reversed.

permanent.label: Permanently delete
permanent.hint: Targets are deleted directly from disk to free up space immediately. Each run requires confirmation.

appearance.lockedToLight: {{name}} is a light theme — it carries no colours for the other, so this follows it.
appearance.lockedToDark: {{name}} is a dark theme — it carries no colours for the other, so this follows it.

dark.label: Dark
dark.hint: Sleek dark theme optimized for low-light development environments.

system.label: System
system.hint: Automatically follows your operating system appearance preference.

appearance.themesIntro: A theme file renames some of the app's colours and leaves the rest, so one written today still works after a release adds a surface.

files.label: Your settings and themes
files.hint: <mono>{{file}}</mono> and a <mono>{{folder}}</mono> folder, in your own Library. Edit either and come back — both are read again when the window is.

update.ready: Uncached {{version}} is installed — restart to use it

support.title: Support
support.hint: Copy a report to paste into a support request: version, system, plan, the main settings and the end of the log, with your home folder shown as ~. Nothing is sent automatically.
support.failed: The report could not be built.

active.tagline: All features active on this machine
active.renewalEmail: Your receipt and updated key will arrive by email.
active.copyReference: Copy reference, for a support request
active.movingHint: Take your key with you before removing it here.

expired.title: Licence expired
expired.body: Pro features are locked until it is renewed. Everything Free does is untouched — no project and nothing on disk is affected by this.

free.body: Free reclaims every artifact of every project, with no limits. Pro adds the readings that span the whole workspace:

form.placeholder: Paste the key from your receipt
form.partialKey: This looks like part of a key. Paste the whole line from your receipt.
form.failed: Activation failed. Please check your key.
form.offline: Activation is offline. The key carries its own signature, so nothing is sent anywhere and it keeps working without a connection.

errors.licence_malformed: That is not a licence key. Paste the whole line from your receipt.
errors.licence_bad_signature: This key was not issued by Uncached, or it was altered in transit.
errors.licence_unsupported_version: This key needs a newer version of Uncached to read (format {{version}}).
errors.licence_not_pro: This key unlocks "{{plan}}", which this build has nothing to unlock.
errors.licence_no_public_key: This build cannot verify licences. It was compiled without a signing key.

shortcuts.intro: Click a key to record a new one. These are stored in <mono>{{file}}</mono> by action name, so only what you changed is kept and a default that moves in an update moves for you too.
shortcuts.clash: Two commands share a key. Which of them answers to it is not something this app decides — change one.
shortcuts.footer: A key with no modifier only fires when nothing is being typed into, and never appears in the menu bar — the system would claim it, and it would stop reaching what it is for.

palette.label: Command Palette
palette.detail: Every project and every module, by name.

quickClean.label: Reclaim Disk
quickClean.detail: Opens the artifacts the last scan found, ready to review.

settings.label: Settings
settings.detail: The panel. macOS puts this one under the app menu itself.

toggleSidebar.label: Filters
toggleSidebar.detail: Folds the filter column away and back.

focusFilter.label: Filter Projects
focusFilter.detail: Jumps to the filter field from anywhere on the screen.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.detail: The projects, and what they weigh.

maintenance.label: Maintenance
maintenance.detail: The policy, and what it would select.

insights.label: Insights
insights.detail: The workspace as one picture, and what has been reclaimed.
